messages:
Maya K: Hey folks — we need to lock a PIR for the outage from earlier today (INC-2026-0421). Who can host? Prefer one of us who was on-call.
Ravi P: I can host but I have a calendar conflict Tue 9–11 PT. Available otherwise.
Liam O: I can do Tue afternoon or Wed morning PT.
Sofia R: I can shadow and take action notes. Also can pull the customer impact summary.
Maya K: Thanks. IncidentBot, create a PIR draft and add the initial action list.
IncidentBot: PIR draft created: https://calendar.redwood.ai/pir/INC-2026-0421 — provisional 60m slot. Notes: add RCA pre-read by SRE and a customer-impact section. :white_check_mark:
Nadia L: FYI engineering leadership prefers facilitators not be ICs who did the rollback — would either Ravi or Liam be comfortable if neither of you ran the mitigation?
Ravi P: I led the rollback so probably not ideal. Liam can host if he's ok.
Liam O: I can host. I'll schedule Wed 09:00 PT (45 min) unless objections. I'll include Zoom + recording & pre-read request.
Maya K: Works for me. Sofia, can you draft the customer impact blurb and attach error-rate time-series to the doc?
Sofia R: Yep, will attach graphs and a concise timeline by EOD. Also flag affected customers list.
Maya K: Action owners: 
- Postmortem draft: Liam O
- Customer impact: Sofia R
- Telemetry charting: Nadia L
- Follow-up infra actions: Ravi P
Please add to the PIR doc and link to tickets.
Nadia L: Will add charts and the KV cache metrics. Also check whether the fallback policy firing was logged.
Liam O: Scheduling note — I set the invite with 45 min and a 15-min follow-up buffer. Invite sent to oncall, eng-sre, product-support, and affected customer success reps.
IncidentBot: Reminder set: pre-read due 24h before meeting. Auto-invite will include 'pre-read required' tag.
Maya K: Thanks all. If anyone can't make the slot by EOD ping me and we'll swap. Otherwise I'll take the facilitator role + initial draft to get the agenda going.
Ravi P: I'll prep the mitigation timeline and paste it into the doc.
Sofia R: I'll confirm the customer list and provide suggested SL response copy.
Maya K: Great — closing the loop. See you Wed 09:00 PT. :thumbsup:
